verdict.rationale: Buzz documents workflows ('YAML-as-code automation', `buzz workflows trigger`/`approve`) and an event-driven harness that listens for @mentions and prompts an agent, plus lifecycle hooks in Persona Packs, so some automation-on-event exists. The evidence never shows user-authored rules binding arbitrary events to actions; the workflow trigger shown is a manual CLI command and the YAML automation is a one-line vision statement. missing for 10: documented rule/trigger schema for event-based workflows, a list of supported trigger events, worked examples of event-to-action rules, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: The harness listens for @mentions on the relay, prompts your agent, and the agent replies using the Buzz CLI.
